sampling.population: chronological_split == train, filtered lazily before collection
sampling.fold_units: disjoint series; both halves only from original training split

features.h: local encoder state at last observed event; model eval and frozen
features.history_level: mean log1p(nonnegative quantity) over observed events in the current legal context
features.short_history: one observed event gives its log quantity and deviation zero; empty history rejected
features.normalization_fact: T0 already inputs log1p(gap) and log1p(count); this diagnoses explicit accessibility, not absent or RevIN-erased information

retrieval_diagnostics: actual top4 membership and sorted-set paired overlap
actual aggregation weights: uniform 0.25 original, selected-score softmax separate-key
prototype usage effective count and top4 share
within-model selected value projections through its own quantity head
quantity residual projection and memory prediction effect
history-level/deviation descriptive strata fitted on train only

crossfit.original_checkpoint_role: descriptive context, not a second opportunity to pass
crossfit.distance: cosine on normalized h; neighbors only from opposite series fold
crossfit.h_only_control: mean log residual among the 64 cosine neighbors
crossfit.two_stat_probe: h-only correction plus local ridge slopes on the two history statistics
crossfit.standardization: opposite-fold statistics mean and population std only; zero std replaced with one
crossfit.local_fit: neighbor-centered two statistics and label; ridge=1 on summed squared error; unpenalized local intercept
crossfit.metric: MSE of predicting the label-only log1p residual, not a trained candidate performance score
crossfit.bootstrap: 500 deterministic series-cluster resamples of out-of-fold paired squared-error improvement, seed20260905

evidence_gate.if_pass: define one causal two-stat residual query contract, then perform authorized local implementation and conditional 5090 CUDA/e1
evidence_gate.if_fail_or_unassessable: hold query implementation; document missing support and mechanism alternatives without automatically implementing them

limitations: The frozen encoders were trained on all of these train rows; helper crossfit does not make this an independent generalization estimate.
Both checkpoints were selected using validation; this diagnostic never reads validation target rows or held-out results.
Different fitted checkpoints may have different latent coordinate systems. Prototype-ID overlap is descriptive, not semantic equivalence or causal key-only attribution.
Residual decodability does not prove that a query-only gradient path can use the signal or that a fresh model improves.
No completed Instacart weighted-only e300 control exists; effects cannot be attributed solely to key/value separation.
The cluster bootstrap band describes train-internal stability and is not a held-out statistical significance claim.
The fixed sample and linear local probe can miss nonlinear or rare-stratum effects; failure is insufficient support, not impossibility.
